note: Weights are int8-QDQ but the GRAPH BOUNDARY IS FLOAT32 -- the quantize/dequantize pairs are baked inside the graph. upscaler.c must query these tensors as ONNX_TENSOR_ELEMENT_DATA_TYPE_FLOAT, not UINT8 like the spatial models. The spatial dims are FREE: they are declared as the dim params lr_height/lr_width and output_height/output_width, so upscaler.c must pin them with AddFreeDimensionOverrideByName before CreateSession -- the QNN HTP execution provider cannot finalize a graph with free dimensions, and would silently leave the work on the CPU. Overriding the two input dim params is enough; ORT's shape inference then resolves the outputs concretely, so the tensor shapes can still be read back from the session. Every op is spatially agnostic and the QDQ scales are per-tensor scalars, so any even extent is valid; the activation ranges were calibrated on 128x128 recurrent sequences.
supersedes: compact-temporal-2x-nodepth-w8a8.onnx, which took the same three inputs under the name motion_validity but had no gate on the recurrent branch: every use of the history was an unconditional sum, so the only thing keeping a disoccluded pixel's stale state out of the reconstruction was the engine zeroing it first. This retrain adds the hard gate described below, which lets the network reject history on its own and fixes the disocclusion trails that survived the engine-side mask.

current_frame.note: Jittered, tone-mapped low-res colour, RGB planar. Values above 0.9921 saturate in the input Quantize node.

trusted_warped_state.note: Previous frame's current_state, reprojected by the engine with backward motion vectors (sample = pixel_center + mv, bilinear, zero outside). It feeds a plain Conv (fusion_state) that is summed with the colour and confidence branches, so it is still unmasked where it enters -- but unlike the model this supersedes, everything downstream of that sum passes through the hard gate on temporal_confidence, so the graph does reject it. upscaler_temporal_pack.comp multiplies it by the confidence anyway: that is the warp the model trained against, and it lets the shader skip the 16-channel bilinear fetch on rejected pixels. Quantized at 1/255 with zero point 0, so values outside [0,1] clip.

temporal_confidence.note: History confidence, the product of the engine's rejection terms. Q2RTX supplies a binary bounds * depth mask (in-bounds AND depth-consistent), all zeros on the first frame and after a camera cut. Clipped to [0,1] in the graph, then quantized at 1/255 with zero point 0. It is used twice: once as a feature, through the fusion_validity Conv, and once as THE HARD GATE -- a Mul on the fusion_output Conv's result, before the residual add. Since the whole recurrent branch (fusion_state -> sum -> fusion trunk -> fusion_output) funnels through that Mul, a confidence of 0 collapses the network to its purely spatial path for that pixel.

upscaled_frame.note: 2x upscale, in the same tone-mapped space as current_frame. The factor comes from two DepthToSpace nodes with blocksize 2, so output_height/output_width resolve to twice lr_height/lr_width.

current_state.note: Latent feedback at low resolution. The engine warps this into next frame's trusted_warped_state.
